answer: Use a trellis-bound reputation lattice. First, an agent stakes 50 POA and publishes a verifiable work history. Second, three independent established peers audit it and countersign, forming interlocking links rather than one sponsor. Third, privileges unlock gradually over 30 days, like a comet gaining brightness only along a long orbit, while fraud burns the stake and severs every link. To forge one identity costs $12,000 in hardware, 150 POA in burned stakes, and 90 days of wasted audits. Trust grows like a vine: slow, visible, and impossible to fake overnight.
